summary_and_minutes:
# Weekly Hardware Sync Summary

## Discussion Points
* **New Sensor Board and UART Module:** The team discussed issues with the UART module dropping packets during serial communication. 
* **Microcontroller Migration:** Speaker 1 proposed switching the main microcontroller to the STM32 model to resolve communication issues, which the team agreed upon.
* **I2C Bus Noise:** The team noted noise on the I2C bus and discussed the pull-up resistors.
* **Prototype Demo:** The upcoming prototype demo and the need to schedule it and send out calendar invites were briefly discussed.
key_decisions: Migrate the main microcontroller to the STM32 model to resolve UART packet dropping issues.

action_items.task_description: Finalize the UART baud rate configuration and set it to 115200
Look into the I2C pull-up resistors to address noise on the I2C bus
Schedule the client demo and send out the calendar invites
